summary: Two additional literature-supported Fe(110) CH* plus H* coadsorption candidates were constructed for user review and were not submitted.

payload.objective: Screen three Fe45 CH* plus H* coadsorption candidates for the CH* + H* -> CH2* + * initial state, using compatible local relaxations to select one final IS.
current_evidence: Candidate A, CH_long_bridge plus H_adjacent_hollow, remains associated with submitted job `9701350`; its last recorded scheduler checkpoint was RUN and no newer scheduler inference is made by this structure-review event.
Candidate B, CH_top plus H_second_neighbor_hollow, was constructed from verified local CH_top and H_hollow endpoints and passed the construction geometry gate.
Candidate C, CH_long_bridge plus H_adjacent_top, was constructed from verified local CH_long_bridge and H_top endpoints and passed the construction geometry gate.
The literature fallback supports the constituent site motifs and Fe(110) CH+H reaction context, but does not prove either new coadsorbed structure is a relaxed minimum.
Candidates B and C have not been submitted and have no VASP energy, ionic convergence, force, or final-geometry result.
payload.one_executable_step: Obtain the user's structure choice or explicit authorization before preparing or submitting candidates B and C; independently continue the authorized monitoring of job 9701350 when requested by the active workflow.
payload.submission_boundary: Do not submit candidates B or C until the user gives a new explicit instruction after reviewing their structures. No NEB, CI-NEB, DIMER, frequency, or TS submission is authorized.
done_when: All user-approved coadsorption candidates have compatible local relaxation results and geometry classifications.
One retained CH*+H* minimum is selected as IS using compatible local total energies and pathway suitability.
Non-selected converged candidates are registered with provenance; unrelaxed candidates are not promoted as adsorption results.
